title: Tuda Conference
description: TUDA Conference Room — a modern collaborative space shaped by parametric patterns and precise geometric design.
notes: The TUDA Conference Room showcases a refined synthesis of architecture and technology through the use of parametric ceiling patterns and sleek linear elements. The design integrates form and function — angular conference tables, dynamic ceiling geometry, and striped blinds collectively define a space that is both structured and fluid. The monochromatic palette enhances visual harmony, while controlled lighting and acoustic detailing create an environment suited for focused discussions and presentations.
